text:
Janelle Park: idea: run a "Recognition Trolley" next month 11 a roaming cart that visits floors with a tablet for instant kudos + a raffle jar for mini prizes. low-friction, surprise element.
Roberto Silva: fun. logistics? will it block walkways? needs facility sign-off.
Hannah Cho: Facilities: trolley ok if we keep to 1 cart and stick to hallways. need exact route and time windows.
Noah Green: volunteers? we can do 2 people per shift: one to chat, one to operate tablet. I can coordinate rota.
Janelle Park: target windows: 11-12 (lunch), 3-4 (afternoon) weekdays. keep each stop 10-15mins per team.
people-bot: FYI: use `/issue-spot-award <recipient> <amount> <reason>` to log awards. tag awards with `trolley-2026` for reporting.
Roberto Silva: budget? small e-gifts ($10-$20) and a few $50 mini-prizes for raffle. procurement will need vendor details.
James R: Finance: provisional ok. total cap $1,200 for pilot. any award >$100 needs approval. submit PO 2 weeks before.
Hannah Cho: route proposal: floors 2-6, clockwise, avoid labs and emergency exits. will need a small safety briefing for volunteers.
Noah Green: volunteer sign-up sheet link here: https://docs.google.com/sheetstrolley (draft). I'll add slots and a tiny script.
Janelle Park: script idea: "Hi! Quick shout-out? It'll take 30s. Want to enter the raffle?" keep it friendly.
Roberto Silva: poster + desk tent copy: "See the Recognition Trolley! Quick kudos + win a mini-prize." Can design team make a small sticker to put on trolley?
James R: procurement note: if buying physical mini-prizes (pins/stickers) we may need inventory tagging >$100. recommend e-gifts and a 3 small branded pins for in-person winners.
people-bot: Scheduled reminder: "Trolley run checklist" will post to #people-ops 48h before each pilot run.
Hannah Cho: can we do a remote-friendly flow? remote folks should be able to nominate colleagues for raffle and get e-gifts.
Noah Green: yes remote form on QR + short link. volunteers can trigger people-bot to issue e-gift codes for winners.
Janelle Park: include a quick consent checkbox for photos: we might take trolley pics. also ensure raffle rules are clear (no purchase required, opt-in).
Roberto Silva: legal/PR note: add short blurb: photos may be shared internally and optionally on public channels. get consent.
James R: Vendor checklist: supports bulk e-gift CSV, same-day delivery, reasonable fees. please add vendor contact + tax ID to procurement tab.
Noah Green: planning checklist in sheet: route, volunteers, poster, PO, vendor contact, consent text. link: https://docs.google.com/sheetstrolley (same)
Janelle Park: timeline: finalize vendor + PO by Apr 8; route & volunteers by Apr 12; test run Apr 15 morning.
people-bot: Event automation: volunteers with tag `trolley-vol` will receive a DM 24h before their shift with the runbook.
Hannah Cho: facilities will prep a traffic cone and small sign for the trolley to keep flow safe. also will brief building security.
Roberto Silva: can we add a tiny analytics column to track number of kudos + tickets redeemed? Noah can pull weekly CSV.
Noah Green: yep will add analytics tab. want remote vs in-person split and department tags.
Janelle Park: action items: Noah finalize sheet + form; James confirm provisional budget + PO process; Hannah confirm route & safety; Roberto brief design for sticker; people-bot handle reminders.
James R: cc me on PO. looks good for a pilot.
Janelle Park: thanks team! closing thread, will reopen if blockers. :trolley: :sparkles:
